rootCauseFix.bug: DEFAULT_TRANSLATION_ID ('KJV', a Phase 1.2 dev/test-fixture id) was used as a hardcoded fallback in 12 call sites in apps/desktop/src-tauri/src/commands.rs whenever the frontend omitted translationId. In a real Production build (apply_dev_seed never runs), only bible:BSB is registered in the Content Registry, so every one of those call sites silently queried a translation_id that has zero rows - because is_translation_selectable/ensure_translation_selectable deliberately 'fail open' for an unregistered id, this never produced an error, only empty results / failed detection.
